title: Make Remote Agent transport compatible with canonical PR scope enforcement
purpose: Remove the structural contradiction in which Remote Agent execution requires .agent-jobs/**/READY while PR scope rejects every .agent-jobs/** path. Permit only a fully validated three-file Remote Agent transport envelope and enforce the canonical work-package scope against the intended patch and tested result paths.
invariants: Ordinary pull requests continue to reject all generated and transport paths.
A Remote Agent pull request is recognized only when one job directory contains exactly READY, change.patch and job.json.
The job baseCommit must equal the pull-request base SHA and the job branch must use agent/**.
Remote Agent allowedPaths must be unique exact file paths without globs and each must be permitted by the canonical work package named in the pull-request body.
The patch must be applicable text, contain unique paths, and every intended path must satisfy both the job and canonical work-package scopes.
After the tested-result commit, every non-transport changed path must remain inside both the exact job allowedPaths and canonical work-package scope.
No workflow, Remote Agent runner, player source, contract, architecture or platform behavior changes under this work package.
ARC-WP-014 and Stage D remain blocked until this gate repair is merged and the first seam is rerun from the new exact main.
requiredEvidence: focused regression test covering a valid envelope and tested result
negative tests for missing transport files, globbed job paths and canonical-scope escape
PR scope success on this ordinary governance pull request
subsequent Remote Agent envelope and tested-result PR scope success before acceptance
nonGoals: exempt agent branches from canonical scope
change player code or begin Stage D

result.acceptanceGate: focused tests plus successful ARC-WP-014 envelope and tested-result scope evidence

rollback: Revert the validator and focused test. Remote Agent PRs become blocked again by PR scope; no player or learner data rollback is required.
